item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
Smart filter bar + context-aware autocomplete

  • Two-row filter bar with inline BSON validation dots, limit / skip inline, recent-filter chips per collection.
  • "Save query" sheet and keyboard shortcuts (⌘↩ Find, ⌘R Reset, ⌘S Save).
  • Multi-line expand mode for complex filters.
  • Powerful autocomplete: full MQL lexer + state-machine context analyzer. Suggests field names, comparison / logical / array / evaluation / geo operators, BSON types. Works inside quoted strings, nested objects, and $or sub-filters.
